description:
HushPinterest 0.0.5 has 23 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0, and Pinterest 14.25.0 still patches the same way for phones on Android 9. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The big one is Download pin: it now saves image pins at full size. New this time are Remove ad tracking permissions, Hide topic suggestions and Spoof signature for Google sign-in, and Disable analytics turns off more of Google's collection.

## What's new

- Download pin now saves image pins. Pinterest's app is sent display sizes rather than the original for most pins, and the pin menu used to show "Download unavailable" for all of them. Now the download asks Pinterest's media host for the original behind the largest size and saves it, or saves that largest size when there's no original. Copy media link copies the same address, and Supplied media details says which size it describes. Thanks for the report in #2.
- Original-quality images now reaches pin closeups, not only collages. With it on, HushPinterest asks Pinterest for each pin's original along with its display sizes, and the closeup shows the original instead of the large size. Download pin then saves that original directly. Pins Pinterest already loaded keep their size until it loads them again.
- New Remove ad tracking permissions patch, on by default. It takes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services permissions and configuration out of Pinterest's manifest. There's no switch for it, so it stays until you patch again without it. While it's in, Google Play services hands Pinterest an all-zero ad ID even with Hide advertising ID turned off.
- Disable analytics now also turns off Firebase Crashlytics and Performance collection in the manifest, stops Google Analytics from collecting the ad ID, and sets Google's default consent for analytics storage, ad storage, ad user data and ad personalization to denied. Pinterest shipped all four consent defaults as granted. Like the Firebase Analytics flag, this stays until you patch again without the patch.
- New optional Hide topic suggestions patch. It hides the "Ideas you might love" row of topic bubbles under a pin, and the space it took closes up too. The switch starts off. Turn it off again, or pause HushPinterest, and the row comes back the next time Pinterest lays it out. Comments and related pins aren't touched.
- New Spoof signature for Google sign-in patch, off by default. It adds Pinterest's original signing certificate to the manifest so Google sign-in can work in the patched app. That only matters with microG-RE in place of Google Play services, or with the XSpoofSignatures LSPosed module and its permission granted. Stock Google Play services ignores it, and email and password sign-in never needed it.

## Update from 0.0.4

1. Morphe Manager offers 0.0.5 from the HushPinterest patch source. Patch the same Pinterest build you have now and install it over your current Pinterest. Your sign-in and switches stay, as long as Morphe Manager signs it with the same key as before.
2. Remove ad tracking permissions is new and selected by default. Hide topic suggestions and Spoof signature for Google sign-in are new and start unselected, so pick them in Morphe Manager if you want them. Hide topic suggestions also has a switch on the Interface page of HushPinterest settings.
3. Skip Spoof signature for Google sign-in unless your phone runs microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. On a phone with Google Play services it does nothing.

## New install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.38.0**, version code **14388010**, as the universal APK, and patch it. On Android 9, use Pinterest **14.25.0**, version code **14258020**.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 170 patch tests and 693 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto real Pinterest 14.38.0 and 14.25.0 APKs with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 23 patches applied to both without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.5.json` records each of those results, the APK hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

On a signed-in Android 16 phone running patched 14.38.0, Download pin saved the originals behind Pinterest's 736x size (a 541x721 PNG, and a 1134x1621 PNG for a 736x1052 pin), and Copy media link copied the same originals address. With Original-quality images on, the feed loaded, the closeup showed the original and Download pin saved a 1080x1080 JPEG. With Remove ad tracking permissions and the new Disable analytics manifest changes in, Pinterest launched to the signed-in feed without a crash, and the installed app no longer held the ad ID or ad services permissions.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads, AppsFlyer tracking, Bugsnag crash reports and the recommendations Pinterest publishes to Google Engage. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. In the manifest it also turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance collection and Google Analytics' ad ID collection, and sets Google's default analytics and ad consent to denied. That part stays until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.

patches.name: Disable update nag
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's in-app Play Store update prompts. You can still update Pinterest yourself.

patches.name: Download pins
patches.description: Downloads a pin or selected visible grid pins using original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. The pin menu can also copy that media's link. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches.name: Filter pin menu
patches.description: Adds separate switches for collage, visual-search and Promote pin menu entries. Download, share and copy-link actions remain available.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted pins from the home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides Pinterest's ad-only panels. Google's ad SDK isn't started when Pinterest opens. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches.name: Hide advertising ID
patches.description: Pinterest and the ad and tracking code inside it read an all-zero advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same answer Android gives after you delete your ad ID. A switch and Pause hand back the real ID.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from the home feed, search, related pins and boards. AI images without Pinterest's label still show.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Collapses comments panels and comment previews beneath pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins.

patches.name: Hide header buttons
patches.description: Hides trailing header icon buttons. Back buttons, text actions and account controls remain available.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Adds separate switches for the Create, Updates and Search navigation buttons. Home and Profile remain available.

patches.name: Hide save toasts
patches.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as "Saved to" your board or the suggestion to follow the pin's creator. The pin is still saved.

patches.name: Hide search history
patches.description: Hides recent-search rows and carousels on this device. It doesn't delete your account's search history.

patches.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured board placements. Off by default. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings when you want a feed without shopping.

patches.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches.description: Hides the "Ideas you might love" row of topic bubbles under pins without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Its switch starts off, so turn it on in HushPinterest settings.

patches.name: HushPinterest settings
patches.description: Adds HushPinterest settings to Pinterest. Long-press Pinterest's launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Pinterest's App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches.name: No screenshot share menu
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's screenshot observer from opening sharing suggestions. Screenshots still work normally.

patches.name: Open links in your browser
patches.description: Opens pin Visit links and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in keep their usual behavior. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches.name: Original-quality images
patches.description: Asks Pinterest for the original image with each pin and shows it in the pin closeup, and has collages pick the original before the large size. Uses more data.

patches.name: Quiet email reminders
patches.description: Dismisses the optional confirm-your-email reminder. Account verification and sign-in checks still apply.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest. It can't be turned back on in settings, only by patching again without it. While it's in, Hide advertising ID's switch can't hand back the real ID, because Google Play services answers with zeros.

patches.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches.description: Adds Pinterest's original signing certificate to its manifest, so Google sign-in can work in the patched app. It only helps with microG-RE in place of Google Play services, or with the XSpoofSignatures LSPosed module and its permission granted. Stock Google Play services ignores it, and email and password sign-in doesn't need it.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes known tracking parameters from URLs shared or copied from Pinterest. Keeps the destination, other parameters and opaque pin.it links. Turn it off or pause HushPinterest to share the original URLs.

patches.name: System share sheet
patches.description: Uses Android's share sheet when sharing a pin link. Screenshot and download actions keep their usual behavior. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.
